procedure.en: Turn the macro dial clockwise until it cannot move further. That is the start point. Read the number on the macro dial from there.
procedure.pt-BR: Gire o dial principal no sentido horário até não se mover mais. Esse é o ponto inicial. Leia o número no dial principal a partir dali.

notes: Values are Honest Coffee Guide numbers on the 24-position macro dial; decimals fall on the 5-step micro dial (each micro step 0.2 of a macro step). Macro step 0.08 mm = 80 µm and micro step 0.015 mm = 15 µm of burr travel (Timemore knowledge base), not particle size; 120 positions total. Honest Coffee Guide says avoid settings below 3; Timemore's own click ranges for the Chestnut X were not found.
